contracts.authorityImplications: A generation number never grants rights
contracts.definition: An ordered revision within a declared lineage; not a global clock.
contracts.developerPurpose: Detect stale proposals and state transitions
engineeringConventions: Every successful reference commit advances, including empty change; E12 historical request no-op policy was different and remains unchanged
contracts.existingReference: UInt64 fields; no dedicated Generation type
contracts.generationBinding: Candidate binds current base; reference next equals base+1
contracts.invalidationConditions: Current-base applicability ends on advance; overflow rejects
invariants: Never silently reuse a committed generation in a lineage
Compare generation together with lineage and commitment
knownLimitations: UInt64 counter and no-op advancement are engineering choices, not universal research semantics
No distributed clock or durable restart guarantee
contracts.name: Generation
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Historical snapshots remain knowledge after advancement

contracts.authorityImplications: Public State is knowledge, not admitted authority
contracts.definition: Immutable snapshot with declared content, order, lineage and revision.
contracts.developerPurpose: Inspect proposed/current data without giving write rights
engineeringConventions: Toy entry schema is engineering-derived; it is not an E26 backing vector
contracts.existingReference: Existing State with canonical sorted entries and separate order
contracts.invalidationConditions: Advancement does not corrupt history; it makes prior state non-current
invariants: Entry IDs unique
Order is an exact permutation of entry IDs
Snapshot construction grants no currentness
knownLimitations: Synthetic UInt64/Int64 entry domain only
No tensor/model or arbitrary object graph schema
contracts.name: State
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Historical snapshot readable; current status belongs to authority

contracts.definition: Typed state identity scoped by lineage, generation and canonical commitment.
contracts.developerPurpose: Bind requests and evidence to an exact state
engineeringConventions: Proposed tuple is a public contract design; SHA256 is not collision-free proof
contracts.existingReference: Represented by State fields, not a public wrapper
contracts.generationBinding: Include lineage and generation in state identity
contracts.invalidationConditions: Different commitment, revision or lineage changes identity
invariants: Never use a pointer/address as semantic identity
Identity equality is not current admission
knownLimitations: No dedicated StateID type exists
Global collision/namespace ownership not established
contracts.name: StateID
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Stable for exact same declared snapshot

contracts.authorityImplications: A described transition is not an authorization
contracts.definition: A state change considered in relation to an explicit predecessor and successor.
contracts.developerPurpose: Describe state advancement and eventual audit records
engineeringConventions: Durable transition schema/identifier and cross-process history are deferred
contracts.existingReference: CandidateTransition plus commit-returned State realize a small part
contracts.generationBinding: From/to revisions have same admitted lineage
contracts.invalidationConditions: A pending transition fails when its base becomes stale or authority is revoked
invariants: Keep proposal, admission and mutation distinct
Record predecessor applicability before commit
knownLimitations: No durable Transition record/type currently emitted
No branching or history store implementation
contracts.name: Transition
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Committed history persists conceptually; current reference stores only current state and consumed-ticket IDs

contracts.authorityImplications: Must be checked with current authority before commit
contracts.definition: Untrusted proposed next content/order plus exact base identity.
contracts.developerPurpose: Prepare a proposal without mutating current state
engineeringConventions: Specific fields and wire JSON schema are engineering choices
contracts.invalidationConditions: Wrong lineage/generation/commitment, invalid domain or exhaustion reject
invariants: Freely constructing/decoding candidate confers no rights
Validate domain and base before admission
knownLimitations: Wire JSON requires integer-preserving decode
No arbitrary graph witness verification
contracts.name: CandidateTransition

contracts.definition: Declared semantic consequences of a proposal, separated by named predicate.
contracts.developerPurpose: Distinguish relation/value change from order-only or no change
engineeringConventions: Boolean representation is bounded reference design; generic region algebra deferred
contracts.generationBinding: Compare proposed successor with exact base
contracts.invalidationConditions: Recompute change classification against correct base; stale base invalidates prior applicability
invariants: Do not equate numerical equality, dependency equality and history equality
Name the comparison predicate
knownLimitations: Reference only relationChanged/orderChanged booleans
No selective tensor recomputation or complete dependency delta
contracts.name: ConsequentialChange
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Empty semantic delta can coexist with new committed generation in this reference

contracts.authorityImplications: Evidence equality does not transfer issuer rights
contracts.definition: Inspectable statement about a specified state/relationship, with explicit verification scope.
contracts.developerPurpose: Exchange inspectable assertions without granting commit permissions
engineeringConventions: Public witness schema and trust policy are intentionally not inferred from E26 layouts
contracts.generationBinding: Bind statement to exact state commitment and relevant context
contracts.invalidationConditions: Use against mismatched state/context is inapplicable; forged witness handling depends on verifier profile
invariants: Evidence is not Capability
A hash alone does not prove current applicability or archival recovery
knownLimitations: Current Evidence merely contains two commitments and is freely constructible
General witness/attestation verifier absent
contracts.name: Evidence
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Historic evidence may remain valid as history after authority changes

contracts.authorityImplications: Persistent relation is not persistent current authority
contracts.definition: A named association distinct from its traversal or presentation order.
contracts.developerPurpose: Compare semantic association separately from order
engineeringConventions: Unique-entry map is engineering reduction; preserves distinction, not private representation
contracts.generationBinding: Reference relation derives from one State; equality may span generations
contracts.invalidationConditions: Value/association changes invalidate equality; source-driven research eligibility had additional checks
invariants: State exact association predicate and multiplicity policy
Do not substitute multiset equality for ordered equality silently
knownLimitations: Reference relation is unique ID/value mapping, not research coordinate/backing relation
No generic multigraph or duplicate-occurrence schema
contracts.name: Relation
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Equal associations can survive order change

contracts.authorityImplications: Representation evidence never grants current admission
contracts.definition: Exact chosen serialization/layout of a semantic object.
contracts.developerPurpose: Keep canonical format explicit without exposing E26 vector internals
engineeringConventions: First-class representation type deferred; documentation remains public
contracts.existingReference: Private Canonical helper; its wire rule is documented
contracts.generationBinding: Include whichever generation fields the type declares
contracts.invalidationConditions: Profile/schema/meaning changes require new identity domain or migration
invariants: Version encoding explicitly
Exact bytes do not imply authority or semantic applicability
knownLimitations: No generic public Representation object justified
Do not expose opaque encoder spans or private one-shot layout capsules
contracts.name: Representation
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Canonical components may persist only under matching profile and semantics

contracts.authorityImplications: Existing VerifiedTransition combines validation with admitted private capability binding; not pure public validation result
contracts.deferredPureConcept: A pure ValidationResult/VerificationOutcome is deferred until a separately reviewed Verify/Authorize split exists
contracts.definition: A scoped co-admission outcome binding the checks and current private admission context of a proposed transition; not an authority-free validation result or a commit.
engineeringConventions: Future split result/ticket schemas require contract-impact review; no code change now
AdmissionResult is a proposed public name; existing code remains VerifiedTransition and its semantics are unchanged
contracts.existingReference: Existing private-constructor VerifiedTransition is narrower co-admission ticket
contracts.generationBinding: Reference VerifiedTransition binds candidate base indirectly plus issuer/capability epoch
contracts.invalidationConditions: Consumed ticket, stale base, wrong issuer/capability or epoch reject
invariants: Result must state predicate/context and reference base
Do not infer cross-generation applicability
knownLimitations: Generic pure ValidationResult API absent
No cross-generation provenance-decision reuse proved
contracts.name: ValidationResult
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Reference ticket remains pending knowledge until consumed/stale/revoked

contracts.authorityImplications: Capability is permission within trusted bootstrap authority, not user authentication
contracts.definition: Privately issued, scoped permission whose validity must be checked at use.
contracts.developerPurpose: Require possession of current scoped permission at verification and commit
engineeringConventions: UUID identity and epoch are reference engineering choices
contracts.generationBinding: Reference capability binds authority epoch, not generation; candidate ticket supplies base generation
contracts.invalidationConditions: Wrong issuer/epoch, revocation, or different capability for ticket rejects
invariants: Do not serialize/reconstruct private rights from public descriptors
Bind verified ticket to issuing capability identity
knownLimitations: Actor holder may issue/revoke; no external identity authentication
No durable or remote signed capability
contracts.name: Capability
contracts.persistenceBehavior: May remain current over commits within epoch; ticket is one-use and base-bound

contracts.authorityImplications: Trusted bootstrap holder owns reference authority; isolation not claimed
contracts.definition: A current decision boundary permitted to admit/commit state changes under explicit policy.
engineeringConventions: Actor serialization is engineering, not a research proof of isolation
contracts.existingReference: Existing ReferenceAuthority actor; no await between commit rechecks and mutation
contracts.generationBinding: Current actor head and epoch delimit applicability
contracts.invalidationConditions: Revocation and current-head advancement invalidate affected admissions
invariants: Backend/storage/evidence objects cannot grant authority by themselves
Recheck currentness before mutation
knownLimitations: No microkernel/hardware enforcement, authentication, restart durability or distributed consensus
contracts.name: Authority
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Authority applicability distinct from historical structure persistence

contracts.definition: Digest of a precisely defined, versioned preimage used to bind representation/content.
contracts.developerPurpose: Detect mismatched base representation and create deterministic fixture identities
engineeringConventions: Specific fixed-width encoding is ENGINEERING_DERIVED, not validated canonical CBOR
contracts.existingReference: Canonical v1 fixed-binary encoding using CryptoKit SHA256
contracts.generationBinding: State preimage includes lineage and generation; relation preimage intentionally omits them
contracts.invalidationConditions: Changing preimage/profile changes expected binding; cryptographic collision freedom not proved
invariants: Name algorithm/domain/preimage rules
Do not hash Swift native memory layout
Do not call history-chain or inventory hashes full-state/Merkle proofs
knownLimitations: Current public values are lowercase SHA256 strings, not dedicated typed Commitment
Hash security is library/algorithm reliance
contracts.name: Commitment
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Same canonical preimage gives same digest within profile

contracts.authorityImplications: Observed success is not a reusable capability
contracts.definition: Explicit outcome distinguishing committed new state from rejected, unchanged authority state.
contracts.developerPurpose: Make state mutation effects visible to callers
engineeringConventions: Result wrapper design would be new API work, not performed
contracts.existingReference: commit returns State or throws typed Rejection
contracts.generationBinding: Success returns next generation; failure retains previous state
contracts.invalidationConditions: An outcome cannot be replayed as permission
invariants: Only successful commit may advance current head
Rejected reference commit must not mutate current state
knownLimitations: No dedicated CommitResult type or durable commit receipt
Broad failure atomicity not formally verified
contracts.name: CommitResult
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Outcome can be retained as history, but no durable receipt implementation exists

contracts.authorityImplications: Object identity does not authorize access
contracts.definition: Potential canonical semantic object identifier distinct from backend address and storage location.
engineeringConventions: Do not promote canonical CBOR or global content address merely to fill API
contracts.existingReference: No canonical ObjectID type; current toy IDs only
contracts.generationBinding: Object-level and state-version-level identity must not be conflated
invariants: Identity domain must be explicit
Storage location/pointer not identity
knownLimitations: No general object schema/global namespace or canonical ObjectID profile validated
Reference Entry.id and lineage are synthetic integers, not complete ObjectID
contracts.name: ObjectID
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Would identify object across revisions under chosen schema

contracts.authorityImplications: EvidenceRoot grants no runtime/research execution authority
contracts.definition: Typed descriptor of an evidence commitment including commitment kind, algorithm and inventory/schema interpretation.
contracts.developerPurpose: Link SDK release research basis to an immutable acceptance boundary
engineeringConventions: Metadata descriptor is release-engineering convention; primary inventory semantics unchanged
contracts.existingReference: Release provenance can carry E26 canonical inventory SHA256; no runtime API
contracts.generationBinding: Research acceptance binds exact frozen evidence; runtime generation roots require separately specified profile
contracts.invalidationConditions: Different inventory bytes/membership/schema invalidate same-root claim
invariants: Declare whether inventory, graph, tree or history-chain commitment
Never relabel canonical inventory SHA256 as Merkle root
Hash is not backup or authority
knownLimitations: Current reference has no EvidenceRoot runtime type
General proof paths/partial membership verification deferred
contracts.name: EvidenceRoot
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Frozen inventory commitment persists as historical evidence identity

contracts.authorityImplications: Current verify method checks capability and admissibility together; commit remains distinct
contracts.definition: Small contract checking candidate domain, immediate base binding and current scoped admission before commit.
contracts.developerPurpose: Expose bounded rejection behavior without pretending full proof engine
engineeringConventions: ReferenceVerifier is the 17th evaluated component from §12; §8 itself lists 16
contracts.generationBinding: Immediate current base only; no recursive parent graph
contracts.invalidationConditions: Domain/base mismatch, stale generation, replay, revocation and wrong capability reject
invariants: State precisely which validity clauses are implemented
Failure does not imply repaired evidence or automatic fallback
Current commit rechecks applicable predicates
knownLimitations: General ParentsValid/WitnessValid absent; no formal verification or hardware enforcement
contracts.name: ReferenceVerifier
contracts.persistenceBehavior: Historical check results do not preserve current authority

normativeInvariant: Structural persistence does not imply authority persistence
